5:   def pbAbilitiesOnSwitchOut
6:     if abilityActive?
7:       Battle::AbilityEffects.triggerOnSwitchOut(self.ability, self, false)
8:     end
9:     # Reset form
10:     @battle.peer.pbOnLeavingBattle(@battle, @pokemon, @battle.usedInBattle[idxOwnSide][@index / 2])
11:     # Check for end of Neutralizing Gas/Unnerve
12:     if hasActiveAbility?(:NEUTRALIZINGGAS)
13:       # Treat self as fainted
14:       @hp = 0
15:       @fainted = true
16:       pbAbilitiesOnNeutralizingGasEnding
17:     elsif hasActiveAbility?([:UNNERVE, :ASONECHILLINGNEIGH, :ASONEGRIMNEIGH])
18:       # Treat self as fainted
19:       @hp = 0
20:       @fainted = true
21:       pbItemsOnUnnerveEnding
22:     end
23:     # Treat self as fainted

30:   def pbAbilitiesOnFainting
31:     # Self fainted; check all other battlers to see if their abilities trigger
32:     @battle.pbPriority(true).each do |b|
33:       next if !b || !b.abilityActive?
34:       Battle::AbilityEffects.triggerChangeOnBattlerFainting(b.ability, b, self, @battle)
35:     end
36:     @battle.pbPriority(true).each do |b|
37:       next if !b || !b.abilityActive?
38:       Battle::AbilityEffects.triggerOnBattlerFainting(b.ability, b, self, @battle)
39:     end
40:     pbAbilitiesOnNeutralizingGasEnding if hasActiveAbility?(:NEUTRALIZINGGAS, true)
41:     pbItemsOnUnnerveEnding if hasActiveAbility?([:UNNERVE, :ASONECHILLINGNEIGH, :ASONEGRIMNEIGH], true)
42:   end

62:   def pbAbilitiesOnNeutralizingGasEnding
63:     return if @battle.pbCheckGlobalAbility(:NEUTRALIZINGGAS)
64:     @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("The effects of the neutralizing gas wore off!"))
65:     @battle.pbEndPrimordialWeather
66:     @battle.pbPriority(true).each do |b|
67:       next if b.fainted?
68:       next if !b.unstoppableAbility? && !b.abilityActive?
69:       Battle::AbilityEffects.triggerOnSwitchIn(b.ability, b, @battle)
70:     end

73:   # Called when a Pokémon (self) enters battle, at the end of each move used,
74:   # and at the end of each round.
75:   def pbContinualAbilityChecks(onSwitchIn = false)
76:     # Check for end of primordial weather
77:     @battle.pbEndPrimordialWeather
78:     # Trace
79:     if hasActiveAbility?(:TRACE)
80:       # NOTE: In Gen 5 only, Trace only triggers upon the Trace bearer switching
81:       #       in and not at any later times, even if a traceable ability turns
82:       #       up later. Essentials ignores this, and allows Trace to trigger
83:       #       whenever it can even in Gen 5 battle mechanics.
84:       choices = @battle.allOtherSideBattlers(@index).select do |b|
85:         next !b.ungainableAbility? &&
86:              ![:POWEROFALCHEMY, :RECEIVER, :TRACE].include?(b.ability_id)
87:       end
88:       if choices.length > 0
89:         choice = choices[@battle.pbRandom(choices.length)]
90:         @battle.pbShowAbilitySplash(self)
91:         self.ability = choice.ability
92:         @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} traced {2}'s {3}!", pbThis, choice.pbThis(true), choice.abilityName))
93:         @battle.pbHideAbilitySplash(self)
94:         if !onSwitchIn && (unstoppableAbility? || abilityActive?)
95:           Battle::AbilityEffects.triggerOnSwitchIn(self.ability, self, @battle)
96:         end
97:       end
98:     end
99:   end

114:   # For abilities that grant immunity to moves of a particular type, and raises
115:   # one of the ability's bearer's stats instead.
116:   def pbMoveImmunityStatRaisingAbility(user, move, moveType, immuneType, stat, increment, show_message)
117:     return false if user.index == @index
118:     return false if moveType != immuneType
119:     # NOTE: If show_message is false (Dragon Darts only), the stat will not be
120:     #       raised. This is not how the official games work, but I'm considering
121:     #       that a bug because Dragon Darts won't be fired at self in the first
122:     #       place if it's immune, so why would this ability be triggered by them?
123:     if show_message
124:       @battle.pbShowAbilitySplash(self)
125:       if pbCanRaiseStatStage?(stat, self)
126:         if Battle::Scene::USE_ABILITY_SPLASH
127:           pbRaiseStatStage(stat, increment, self)
128:         else
129:           pbRaiseStatStageByCause(stat, increment, self, abilityName)
130:         end
131:       elsif Battle::Scene::USE_ABILITY_SPLASH
132:         @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("It doesn't affect {1}...", pbThis(true)))
133:       else
134:         @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1}'s {2} made {3} ineffective!", pbThis, abilityName, move.name))
135:       end
136:       @battle.pbHideAbilitySplash(self)
137:     end
138:     return true
139:   end

141:   # For abilities that grant immunity to moves of a particular type, and heals
142:   # the ability's bearer by 1/4 of its total HP instead.
143:   def pbMoveImmunityHealingAbility(user, move, moveType, immuneType, show_message)
144:     return false if user.index == @index
145:     return false if moveType != immuneType
146:     # NOTE: If show_message is false (Dragon Darts only), HP will not be healed.
147:     #       This is not how the official games work, but I'm considering that a
148:     #       bug because Dragon Darts won't be fired at self in the first place
149:     #       if it's immune, so why would this ability be triggered by them?
150:     if show_message
151:       @battle.pbShowAbilitySplash(self)
152:       if canHeal? && pbRecoverHP(@totalhp / 4) > 0
153:         if Battle::Scene::USE_ABILITY_SPLASH
154:           @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1}'s HP was restored.", pbThis))
155:         else
156:           @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1}'s {2} restored its HP.", pbThis, abilityName))
157:         end
158:       elsif Battle::Scene::USE_ABILITY_SPLASH
159:         @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("It doesn't affect {1}...", pbThis(true)))
160:       else
161:         @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1}'s {2} made {3} ineffective!", pbThis, abilityName, move.name))
162:       end
163:       @battle.pbHideAbilitySplash(self)
164:     end
165:     return true
166:   end

168:   #=============================================================================
169:   # Ability change
170:   #=============================================================================
171:   def pbOnLosingAbility(oldAbil, suppressed = false)
172:     if oldAbil == :NEUTRALIZINGGAS && (suppressed || !@effects[PBEffects::GastroAcid])
173:       pbAbilitiesOnNeutralizingGasEnding
174:     elsif [:UNNERVE, :ASONECHILLINGNEIGH, :ASONEGRIMNEIGH].include?(oldAbil) &&
175:           (suppressed || !@effects[PBEffects::GastroAcid])
176:       pbItemsOnUnnerveEnding
177:     elsif oldAbil == :ILLUSION && @effects[PBEffects::Illusion]
178:       @effects[PBEffects::Illusion] = nil
179:       if !@effects[PBEffects::Transform]
180:         @battle.scene.pbChangePokemon(self, @pokemon)
181:         @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1}'s {2} wore off!", pbThis, GameData::Ability.get(oldAbil).name))
182:         @battle.pbSetSeen(self)
183:       end
184:     end
185:     @effects[PBEffects::GastroAcid] = false if unstoppableAbility?
186:     @effects[PBEffects::SlowStart]  = 0 if self.ability != :SLOWSTART
187:     @effects[PBEffects::Truant]     = false if self.ability != :TRUANT
188:     # Check for end of primordial weather
189:     @battle.pbEndPrimordialWeather
190:     # Revert form if Flower Gift/Forecast was lost
191:     pbCheckFormOnWeatherChange(true)
192:     # Abilities that trigger when the terrain changes
193:     pbAbilityOnTerrainChange(true)
194:   end

196:   def pbTriggerAbilityOnGainingIt
197:     # Ending primordial weather, checking Trace
198:     pbContinualAbilityChecks(true)   # Don't trigger Traced ability as it's triggered below
199:     # Abilities that trigger upon switching in
200:     if (!fainted? && unstoppableAbility?) || abilityActive?
201:       Battle::AbilityEffects.triggerOnSwitchIn(self.ability, self, @battle)
202:     end
203:     # Status-curing ability check
204:     pbAbilityStatusCureCheck
205:     # Check for end of primordial weather
206:     @battle.pbEndPrimordialWeather
207:   end

217:   def canConsumePinchBerry?(check_gluttony = true)
218:     return false if !canConsumeBerry?
219:     return true if @hp <= @totalhp / 4
220:     return true if @hp <= @totalhp / 2 && (!check_gluttony || hasActiveAbility?(:GLUTTONY))

224:   # permanent is whether the item is lost even after battle. Is false for Knock
225:   # Off.
226:   def pbRemoveItem(permanent = true)
227:     @effects[PBEffects::ChoiceBand] = nil if !hasActiveAbility?(:GORILLATACTICS)
228:     @effects[PBEffects::Unburden]   = true if self.item && hasActiveAbility?(:UNBURDEN)
229:     setInitialItem(nil) if permanent && self.item == self.initialItem
230:     self.item = nil
